entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one polished photorealistic full-length men's outfit portrait for Fit Picker. Portrait 2:3 composition, warm ivory seamless backdrop and soft studio daylight with natural contact shadow. One East Asian adult male fashion model with short dark hair and natural proportions, centered from top of hair to the soles with comfortable margins. Show textures, garment lengths and footwear clearly. Use reference 1 for the exact construction and color of the outerwear, and the other reference images for the other garment pieces in the same order as the description. Take styling from the supplied pieces. No captions, collage, accessories, bag or framing graphics. The outerwear is a beige single-breasted wool-look coat with notch lapels and dark buttons, falling closer to the knee than the hip. Wear it open over a navy short-sleeve button-through shirt, tailored grey slacks and all-black low-top Adidas trainers. Calm smart casual, suitable for a mild autumn dinner.
